name: perimeter-sentry-turnaround-v1
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2x2 four-view game sprite turnaround sheet for PHIELDWORKS. A compact automated perimeter sentry: chunky low steel pedestal on a square bolted base, off-white ceramic casing, copper conduits, a short conventional twin-barrel defensive turret and cyan sensor strip. Industrial semiconductor-factory aesthetic, restrained weathering, not a futuristic floating weapon. Exact four equal cells, top left facing southeast, top right southwest, bottom left northwest, bottom right northeast, physically rotate the same 3D turret by quarter turns while maintaining the same fixed oblique overhead camera and upright verticals. World lighting upper-left in every view. Each whole machine centered inside its own cell with 15% transparent margin, consistent scale. Genuine transparent background. No text, labels, border, floor or scene. Detailed chunky game art readable at 60 pixels.
